typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DestinationTable as string (),
	FileDate as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileNamePrev as string (),
	PackageExecutionID as integer (),
	RowsDeleted as integer (),
	RowsDiscarded as integer (),
	RowsInserted as integer (),
	RowsNotWrittenError as integer (),
	RowsReadError as integer (),
	RowsReadNoError as integer (),
	RowsUpdated as integer (),
	Variable as integer (),
	FileArchiveDir as string (),
	FilePattern as string (),
	FileProcessDir as string (),
	ParentPackageExecutionID as integer (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		{PROJECT NUMBER} as string,
		{SO ID} as string,
		{SO-STATUS} as string,
		SHIPMENT as string,
		{JOURNAL NUMBER} as string,
		{G L JOURNAL DATE} as string,
		{INVOICE NUMBER} as string,
		{AR TYPE} as string,
		{AR RECORD CREATED} as string,
		{ORDER DATE} as string,
		{SHIP DATE} as string,
		{INVOICE DATE} as string,
		{UPDATE DATE} as string,
		{CUST CODE} as string,
		SEQ as string,
		{CUSTOMER NAME} as string,
		{JOB NAME} as string,
		{TRAN TYPE} as string,
		{SALE TYPE} as string,
		{PAY TERM} as string,
		{REP 1} as string,
		{REP 2} as string,
		{SHIP VIA} as string,
		{FGT TERMS} as string,
		{CHARGE TYPE} as string,
		{CHARGE AMOUNT} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> Readfromcsv
Readfromcsv derive({PROJECT NUMBER} = {PROJECT NUMBER}) ~> PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError
Readfromcsv derive() ~> ReadfromcsvErrorReformat
PlaceHolderRowsReadNoError derive(FileName = toString(replace($FileNamePrev, toString($FileProcessDir), toString(''))),
		ETLCreateDate = $startTime,
		ETLExecutionID = $PackageExecutionID,
		FileDate = toString((iif(locate('1_to_', $FileNamePrev, 1) > 0, toString(year(currentTimestamp())) + '0101', right(replace($FileNamePrev, toString('.csv'), toString('')), 8)))),
		{CHARGE AMOUNT} = replace({CHARGE AMOUNT}, toString('\r'), toString(''))) ~> DeriveAuditandOtherColumns
ReadfromcsvErrorReformat derive() ~> Readfromcsv0
DeriveAuditandOtherColumns sink(input(
		ETLCreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CHARGE_AMOUNT as string,
		{SO-STATUS} as string,
		SHIPMENT as string,
		UPDATE_DATE as string,
		FileName as string,
		TRAN_TYPE as string,
		FGT_TERMS as string,
		REP_1 as string,
		AR_TYPE as string,
		SHIP_VIA as string,
		JOURNAL_NUMBER as string,
		G_L_JOURNAL_DATE as string,
		JOB_NAME as string,
		INVOICE_DATE as string,
		FileDate as string,
		REP_2 as string,
		PAY_TERM as string,
		SHIP_DATE as string,
		CUST_CODE as string,
		CHARGE_TYPE as string,
		ORDER_DATE as string,
		SALE_TYPE as string,
		PROJECT_NUMBER as string,
		SO_ID as string,
		INVOICE_NUMBER as string,
		CUSTOMER_NAME as string,
		ETLExecutionID as long,
		AR_RECORD_CREATED as string,
		SEQ as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ETLCreateDate,
		CHARGE_AMOUNT = {CHARGE AMOUNT},
		{SO-STATUS},
		SHIPMENT,
		UPDATE_DATE = {UPDATE DATE},
		FileName,
		TRAN_TYPE = {TRAN TYPE},
		FGT_TERMS = {FGT TERMS},
		REP_1 = {REP 1},
		AR_TYPE = {AR TYPE},
		SHIP_VIA = {SHIP VIA},
		JOURNAL_NUMBER = {JOURNAL NUMBER},
		G_L_JOURNAL_DATE = {G L JOURNAL DATE},
		JOB_NAME = {JOB NAME},
		INVOICE_DATE = {INVOICE DATE},
		FileDate,
		REP_2 = {REP 2},
		PAY_TERM = {PAY TERM},
		SHIP_DATE = {SHIP DATE},
		CUST_CODE = {CUST CODE},
		CHARGE_TYPE = {CHARGE TYPE},
		ORDER_DATE = {ORDER DATE},
		SALE_TYPE = {SALE TYPE},
		PROJECT_NUMBER = {PROJECT NUMBER},
		SO_ID = {SO ID},
		INVOICE_NUMBER = {INVOICE NUMBER},
		CUSTOMER_NAME = {CUSTOMER NAME},
		ETLExecutionID,
		AR_RECORD_CREATED = {AR RECORD CREATED},
		SEQ)) ~> WritetoStg
Readfromcsv0 sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn()) ~> ReadfromcsvERROROUTPUTFILE
